### Time Out says

This south-east London branch of the popular independent cinema chain, Curzon, shows independent and blockbuster film releases. The venue is also home to the Thirty Five Café, a busy day time and evening eatery. The cinema is linked to the nearby Goldsmiths University and hosts connected events, including an annual film festival.
